text.p: Liuski International Inc said on Tuesday it restated its second quarter results, revising the earnings to a net loss of $1.4 milion, or $0.32 per share, instead of net income of $400,892, or $0.09 per share.
Liuski said it restated the financial results for the three-and six-month periods to reflect increases in reserves and write-offs.
The restated results for the six month period were a net loss of $891,610, or $0.20 per share, instead of a net income of $910,375, or $0.21 per share, the company said.
Reserves for vendor-related receivables increased by $1.6 million and reserves for accounts receivable increased by $1.2 million for the three and six month periods.
For the three and nine months ended September 30, the company said it increased its reserves for vendor-related receivables and write-offs by $585,022 and $2.2 million, respectively.
Liuski said it increased its reserve for inventory obsolescence by $203,000 in the third quarter of 1996.

The company also increased its reserve for doubtful accounts receivable by $1.6 million for the third quarter and $2.8 million for the nine months ended September 30. Also, the company posted direct write-offs for bad debt in the amount of about $550,000 in the third quarter of 1996.
